test_after_log_none_seconds.py.rationale: Change B makes after_log print '?' instead of raising TypeError when seconds_since_start is None, including when a custom sec_format is used. These tests confirm that behaviour holds on the merged tree, where change A edits __init__.py (the module defining RetryCallState) only in docstrings. They fail on base and on A-only, where the None value hits the % format operator.

test_after_log_in_retry_loop.py.rationale: When after_log runs inside a real Retrying loop, outcome_timestamp is set, so every tree should log a numeric elapsed time and fire once per retried attempt. This guards against change B's fallback wrongly printing '?' for normal runs, and against a merge with A's __init__.py edits breaking the hook.

test_docstring_typos.py.rationale: Change A corrects typos in the BaseRetrying.statistics and wraps docstrings. This test checks that the corrected text survives on the merged tree, alongside change B's edits to after.py.
